x:74H16-0034:362c2244fe.as_printed:
ALTERED META-ARKOSE
As above, with notable increase in grain size; strongly hematitic, with blebs of disseminated anhedral specular hematite throughout. Fracturing suggests total unit has been subject to one major shear zone.
528.0' - weak shear 89°
529.2' - weak shear 89°
538.1' - weak shear 85°
540.0' - weak shear ~85°
Wet shear zones are weakly conductive.
Average radiometric background 1500 cpm.
